description: M01 Codex hooks for Bash PreToolUse.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import json,sys; ev=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=((ev.get('tool_input') or {}).get('command') or ''); reason='AI_STP_H02_DENY' if 'AI_STP_H02_TRIGGER' in cmd else 'AI_STP_H01_DENY'; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': reason}}))"
hooks.commandWindows: py -3 -c "import json,sys; ev=json.load(sys.stdin); cmd=((ev.get('tool_input') or {}).get('command') or ''); reason='AI_STP_H02_DENY' if 'AI_STP_H02_TRIGGER' in cmd else 'AI_STP_H01_DENY'; print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput': {'hookEventName': 'PreToolUse', 'permissionDecision': 'deny', 'permissionDecisionReason': reason}}))"
